# Documentation Rules

- Link to authoritative files instead of duplicating long hardware explanations.
- Document runtime boundaries, ownership, protected contracts, and validation commands.
- Mark generated artifacts and their source pipelines clearly.
- Use Mermaid for cross-module flows when a diagram improves maintenance.
- Keep documentation aligned with actual code and current board behavior.
